gloss: a corner, a section, one part of

definitions.gloss: a corner, a section, one part of
definitions.explanation: A part or section of a larger area or group. Refers to a specific portion within something bigger.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}の{一角|いっかく}にカフェがある。
examples.english: There is a café in a corner of the park.

examples.japanese: {街|まち}の{一角|いっかく}に{古|ふる}い{神社|じんじゃ}がある。
examples.english: There is an old shrine in a corner of the town.

examples.japanese: オフィスの{一角|いっかく}に{休憩|きゅうけい}スペースが{設|もう}けられている。
examples.english: A rest area has been set up in one section of the office.

notes:
{一角|いっかく} means "one corner" or "a section" of a larger space or group.

WORD FORMATION:
{一|いっ} (one) + {角|かく} (corner, angle) = one corner

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜の{一角|いっかく}に: in a corner/section of ~
- {一角|いっかく}を{占|し}める: to occupy a section/position
- {一角|いっかく}を{担|にな}う: to play a part in

NOTE:
When read as ひとかど, it means "respectable" or "notable" (as in ひとかどの{人物|じんぶつ}, a person of some standing). The reading {一角|いっかく} specifically refers to a physical or abstract section.
